topic: Template Class Specialization and SFINAE for Conditional Compilation
explanation: In C++, template class specialization combined with SFINAE (Substitution Failure Is Not An Error) allows developers to create flexible, type-dependent class behaviors. This technique enables the compiler to select the most appropriate class template or function overload based on specific type traits or conditions, facilitating generic programming with compile-time type safety and optimized code paths. It is essential for implementing type traits, enabling or disabling features based on type properties, and writing highly generic yet efficient code.
